مُؤْتَنَفٌ (assumed tropical:) [A place] from which nothing has been eaten; as also ↓ مُتَأَنِّفٌ ; (K;) which latter is explained by Ibn-'Abbád as signifying a place not eaten [from] before. (TA.) ―
-b2- جَارِيَةٌ مُؤْتَنَفَةُ الشَّبَابِ (assumed tropical:) A girl [in the prime of youth;] in whom no trace of agedness appears. (Sgh, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
